description: Curated Apr–Nov 2026 (plus missing 2025–early 2026 landmark) official instruments ready for promotion into data/sources/*.json and ingestion via `make fetch && make parse && make analyze`.
operational_notes: All URLs target authoritative official government, legislative, regulatory, or AI Safety Institute portals.
Post-Sep 29, 2026 U.S. executive publications may use 'Super Intelligence (SI)' terminology pursuant to EO 14434; U.S. discovery targets have been updated accordingly.
Sub-national U.S. state statutes are tracked separately under subnational_overlay_candidates to preserve sovereign-level comparability in core 5-jurisdiction indices.

sovereign_targets.title: Executive Order 14409: Promoting Advanced AI Innovation and Security (91 FR 34565)
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Establishes federal AI cybersecurity clearinghouse and voluntary 30-day pre-release federal evaluation access for frontier developers while rejecting mandatory federal licensing.

sovereign_targets.title: Executive Order 14434: Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence (91 FR 63129)
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Directs executive agencies to adopt 'Super Intelligence (SI)' nomenclature across official non-statutory documents and portals; major framing and terminology pivot.

sovereign_targets.title: Executive Order: Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Establishes DOJ task force challenging fragmented state AI laws and ties BEAD funding to federal preemption principles with carve-outs for child safety, compute, and procurement.

sovereign_targets.title: TAKE IT DOWN Act (Pub. L. 119-12 / S. 146)
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: First binding U.S. federal AI deepfake/NCII criminal and platform takedown statute; FTC 48-hour takedown enforcement entered into force May 19, 2026.

sovereign_targets.title: NIST CAISI AI / SI Agent Standards Initiative & NIST IR 8596 Cyber AI Profile
sovereign_targets.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST / CAISI)
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Core 2026 U.S. technical initiative for autonomous agent identity, IAM, security overlays, and cyber-AI risk management.

sovereign_targets.title: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 amending Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Digital Omnibus on AI)
sovereign_targets.issuing_body: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Major statutory amendment staggering Annex III high-risk AI deadlines to Dec 2, 2027 and Annex I product-safety AI to Aug 2, 2028 while preserving Aug 2, 2026 Art. 50 rules.

sovereign_targets.title: Commission Guidelines on Article 50 AI Act Transparency Obligations (C(2026) 5054 final)
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Operationalizes legally active Aug 2, 2026 Article 50 AI-content marking/disclosure obligations and Dec 2, 2026 legacy watermarking retrofit deadline.

sovereign_targets.title: EU AI Office Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Voluntary compliance code recognized adequate for Article 50 synthetic-content watermarking and provenance obligations.

sovereign_targets.title: Guidelines on the Scope of Obligations for Providers of General-Purpose AI Models (Full Annex to C(2025) 5045 final)
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Replaces current 3,383-char 2-page cover Communication stub (eu_gpai_scope_obligations_guidelines_2025) with the full ~40-page technical Guidelines Annex.

sovereign_targets.title: 인공지능 안전성 확보 가이드라인 (Finalized MSIT AI Safety Assurance Guideline)
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Finalized MSIT safety assurance guideline replacing the Jan 2026 draft (kr_ai_safety_guideline_2026_draft) under the AI Basic Act.

sovereign_targets.title: 인공지능 발전과 신뢰 기반 조성 등에 관한 기본법 일부개정법률 (Oct 2026 Cabinet AI & Data Industry Act Amendments)
sovereign_targets.issuing_body: Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) / Government of the Republic of Korea
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Oct 13, 2026 amendment expanding lawful public/private AI training data sharing to address domestic training data bottlenecks.

sovereign_targets.title: South Korea National AI Action Plan (2026–2028) — AI G3 & Sovereign Compute Strategy
sovereign_targets.issuing_body: Presidential Council on National AI Strategy (NAISC) / MSIT
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: 99-task national execution plan targeting AI G3 competitiveness and sovereign compute infrastructure.

sovereign_targets.title: 第2期 人工知能基本計画 (Second AI Basic Plan — 'Japan AI Transformation')
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Cabinet Decision of July 14, 2026 superseding the Dec 2025 First Plan; pivots to agentic AI, physical/vertical AI, chips/power sovereignty, and 180k-seat government GENAI rollout.

sovereign_targets.title: AI事業者ガイドライン (第1.2版) / AI Guidelines for Business Ver. 1.2
sovereign_targets.issuing_body: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (MIC) and Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI)
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Supersedes corpus Ver. 1.0 (Apr 2024); explicitly introduces AI agent and physical AI governance obligations across developers, providers, and business users.

sovereign_targets.title: 人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の推進に関する法律 (Act No. 53 of 2025 — Full Statutory Text)
sovereign_targets.issuing_body: National Diet of Japan / Cabinet Office
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Full statutory text of Japan's AI Promotion Act (Act No. 53 of 2025); currently only a 1-page English overview slide is in the corpus.

sovereign_targets.title: J-AISI Guide to Evaluation Perspectives & Red Teaming Methodology on AI Safety
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Authoritative Japan AI Safety Institute technical evaluation and red-teaming standards; also pair with Hiroshima AI Process Code of Conduct (https://www.soumu.go.jp/hiroshimaaiprocess/en/index.html).

sovereign_targets.title: 人工智能安全治理框架 3.0 (AI Safety Governance Framework v3.0)
sovereign_targets.issuing_body: National Technical Committee 260 on Cybersecurity (TC260) / Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC)
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Supersedes v1.0 (2024) and v2.0 (2025); first national technical framework specifying 8-stage agentic AI controls (agent identity, least-privilege permissions, dynamic revocation, default-deny, kill-switches) and embodied AI risk tiers.

sovereign_targets.title: 中华人民共和国网络安全法 (2025 Revision — Effective Jan 1, 2026, Art. 20 AI Governance)
sovereign_targets.issuing_body: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (NPCSC)
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: Adds Article 20 codifying AI R&D, compute/data infrastructure, ethics, and risk monitoring into national primary legislation with penalties up to RMB 50M / 5% turnover.

sovereign_targets.title: 国务院关于深入实施“人工智能+”行动的意见 (国发〔2025〕11号) & Mandatory Standard GB 45438-2025
sovereign_targets.issuing_body: State Council of the People's Republic of China / MIIT / TC260
sovereign_targets.relevance_notes: State Council AI+ deployment mandate (>70% AI agent/smart terminal adoption by 2027) paired with mandatory national standard GB 45438-2025 operationalizing synthetic content labeling.

subnational_overlay_candidates.note: Excluded from federal sovereign index; tracked for opt-in U.S. state overlay.

subnational_overlay_candidates.note: Excluded from federal sovereign index; tracked for opt-in U.S. state overlay.
